villas.name: Villa Nova
villas.tagline: Seven bedrooms in the middle of Brickell.
villas.description: The big-group house. Seven bedrooms and six and a half baths, sleeping fourteen, minutes on foot from Brickell's restaurants and nightlife. Built for the trip where everyone comes.

villas.name: Villa Eden
villas.tagline: A sun-drenched, Eden-themed haven on the edge of the Design District.
villas.description: High ceilings and modern finishes in a bright, open space built for relaxation and connection. Buena Vista is a historic Miami neighborhood next to the Wynwood Arts District and the Design District — charming early-1900s homes, tree-lined streets, and the city's best galleries, boutiques and restaurants a short stroll away.

villas.name: Santorini
villas.tagline: Mediterranean waterfront estate with a private dock and the skyline across the bay.
villas.description: Paradise on Pine Tree Drive — the waterfront gem of Miami Beach. Eight bedrooms across a main house and a separate four-bedroom guest house, sleeping 26, with a large bay-front pool, waterfront yard, hammock, basketball net in the pool, ping-pong, outdoor kitchen and multiple lounging terraces looking at the skyline. A grand piano under coffered ceilings inside; a private dock for the yacht day outside. Minutes from the beaches, dining and nightlife.

villas.name: Athena
villas.tagline: Dark-modern estate: marble, black lacquer, and a night-lit pool.
villas.description: Moody and sharp — a black-and-white palette, book-matched marble feature walls, a full billiards lounge and a black kitchen bar. Every bedroom is hotel-grade with its own spa bath and rain shower; the master has a walk-in closet the size of a bedroom. Out back, a lit pool set in a lawn under the trees.

villas.name: Villa Babette · Hibiscus Island
villas.tagline: Waterfront privacy on Hibiscus Island, five minutes from the beach.
villas.description: A one-of-a-kind Miami Beach villa in an incredibly private corner of Hibiscus Island. Lush, meandering gardens of palms and tropical plants, a pristine heated 50-foot pool, a Spanish-inspired fountain, private dock and terrace, and a fully detached poolside guest house. Three roomy en-suite bedrooms in the main house plus the guest suite; a sunroom with panoramic windows for slow mornings.
villas.notes: 5 min to the beach · 20 min to the airport · 10 min to golf

villas.name: Playa Castillo
villas.tagline: Six bedrooms on the Venetian Islands.
villas.description: Island living between downtown and South Beach — six bedrooms, waterfront setting, and the Venetian Causeway at your door. Professionally photographed, drone views included. Full specs and availability on request.
source_dirs: playacastillo/Low res (For web use including MLS)

villas.name: Ikon
villas.tagline: Rooftop pool over the Brickell skyline.
villas.description: A modern white cube minutes from Brickell with the money shot up top: a rooftop pool and lounge deck looking at the towers. Downstairs is gallery-white — double-height living, a glass-railed staircase, an open chef's kitchen with island seating, ping-pong, and a two-car garage. Bedrooms in tufted headboards and marble baths.

villas.name: Villa Posh
villas.tagline: Rooftop pool with the Brickell skyline.
villas.description: A 3,500-square-foot oasis in The Roads — tree-lined residential calm with Brickell's financial district, Wynwood Walls and Coconut Grove all a short drive away. The exclusive rooftop pool, rooftop grill and lounge are the reason people book it twice.

villas.name: Carriage
villas.tagline: Black modern architecture with a games room and a pool under the oaks.
villas.description: A Victorian-inspired luxury home in Buena Vista with high ceilings, bold murals and an open, airy layout — black modern architecture outside, royal-portrait art and a games room inside (billiards, shuffleboard, wine fridge). Cook in the gourmet kitchen, lounge under the covered wood-ceiling patio with its outdoor kitchen, or soak by the heated pool on the lawn under the oaks. The charming carriage in the backyard is the photo everyone posts. Five bedrooms including a bunk room, sleeping twelve.

villas.name: Little Haiti Villa
villas.tagline: Newly built, 25-foot glass façade, absolute privacy.
villas.description: A striking, newly built single-family home — sleek luxury and total privacy behind a breathtaking 25-foot double-height glass storefront façade. Inside, a sun-drenched, open-concept architectural haven that feels grand and welcoming at once. Set in a quiet canopy-lined enclave moments from the Design District, Upper Buena Vista's artisan shops and Wynwood's galleries.

villas.name: Bond
villas.tagline: All-white, high-vaulted, built for the party.
villas.description: A tropical resort hidden in the heart of Miami, minutes from the beach and the airport — a fusion of two large houses on the historic Miami River near Kiki on the River. Eight bedrooms sleeping twenty, plus a movie theater, poker room, gym, billiards and ping-pong, all around a pool and jacuzzi framed by palms. The all-white vaulted great room is the party; the guest house is the escape.
